description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus that declare, import or use the names of the 2.3 library packages (WP3): own sqrt, now, intText, realText, boolText, clampInt, minInt, maxInt and clamp as package, component and nested operations, locals, parameters and members; Numeric, Text and Time as package, component, attribute, enum literal and operation names; imports of every 2.2 library package next to them; ambiguity messages with their related information; an own now in an initializer, in a receive guard and before a suspension (SW2011). Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar except w16, which records that a wildcard import does not parse. Their diagnostics (with related information), normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp3.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.
